title: OpenJammer PluginManifest v1
description: The ONE manifest every node type (built-in DSP, Faust, AI-WASM, hosted plugin) is described by. `id` is the OPEN registry key; `kind` is the CLOSED PrimitiveKind the real-time loop lowers it to. Frozen v1: dsp.kind in {builtin,faust,wasm,none}, ui.kind in {auto,react}.

id.description: OPEN registry key (arbitrary, namespaced string, e.g. "builtin.gain").

kind.description: CLOSED PrimitiveKind the RT loop lowers `id` to (serde unit-variant name).

dsp.description: How the node's audio is computed (selects the executor backend).

ui.description: How the node's control surface is presented.

params.description: Declared numeric parameters, addressed at runtime by `id`.

audio_in_channels.description: Channels per audio INPUT port (1=mono, 2=stereo). Default 1 (docs/CHANNELS.md).

audio_out_channels.description: Channels per audio OUTPUT port. Default 1 (mono).

abi.description: Additive ABI / capability-negotiation block (docs/STABILITY.md §4). OPTIONAL and strictly additive: absent = a pre-abi plugin targeting the base contract, declaring no capabilities or permissions.

contract.description: Kernel contract generation the plugin was built against (informational).

min_contract.description: Oldest kernel contract that can load this plugin (the load gate).

capabilities.description: Capabilities the plugin uses; `oj.*` ids are kernel-reserved, `vendor.*` is community. An unknown REQUIRED capability degrades the node to a labeled passthrough stub; an unknown OPTIONAL one is simply not offered.

permissions.description: Coarse permissions the plugin declares it needs. DECLARED here; ENFORCED out-of-process at the OS sandbox token.
